I'll share my story to get things rolling.

It was 2000 and I only had my first computer for a year or so.. This was when AOL, Yahoo, and Yahoo chat was all the rage. You could find a room on Ychat for just about any subject. I loved to frequent the general music room. I should mention I was 15 at the time and just barely computer savvy to know what I was doing.

So one cold winter day I got home from school and decided to dial up and log in to good ole Yahoo chat. I hopped on Music and in usual antagonizing teen fashion decided to post a derogatory message toward a certain band I didn't like. The object of my disdain was Linkin Park as it was common for my friends and I to shit on them at the time all while incessantly blathering on about how cool and heavy Slipknot and Mudvayne was. So I simply typed "Linkin Park sucks!" and waited for any positive or negative feedback.

No one really took any interest in my statement until I received a PM with the simple message of "Fuck you." So I replied in turn. Then my blood ran cold when I received another reply stating "Say goodbye to anything on your computer." I didn't know much about computers them but this was a threat I had not encountered as of yet. I asked "What do you mean?" "Oh you'll find out." was the cryptic response I got. I tried pleading with the guy to take it back but he told me to fuck off and then left the chat.

At this point I didn't notice anything behaving strangely or anything out of the ordinary really but to be sure I did the only thing I knew of at the time to do involving computer problems and restarted. Oh boy. The boot screen and bios were fine but then a dreaded message I will never forget to this day appeared.

OPERATING SYSTEM NOT FOUND.

Shit!

Well I knew the guy's threats were real at this point as he had actually carried through with it. At the time I had no clue how. In my mind my system was fucked and I actually had a mini-freak out as I was going to have to explain how I broke my computer to my parents. Not to mention losing all those sweet Napster downloads and my tiny pixelated collection of porn.

Luckily instead I ended up calling my uncle, who was the family tech guru at the time, and he begrudgingly walked me through the process of using my system's rescue disc to restore my OS. It worked. He also explained what a firewall and antivirus were and why I needed them and also not to antagonize people on the net without these precautions. Safe to say I learned a couple of lessons.

So over the next couple of years I learned more about computers and discovered all my assailant did was use a Y tunneler through my unprotected ports and simply deleted my OS's boot sect. It isn't all that bad if you know what you're doing and can easily fix it but if you don't it's pretty frightening. I should also add that Windows ME was my OS at the time. The damn OS itself was practically malicious code as I would get all sorts of fun blue screens and errors constantly. So yea that about does it.

TL:DR: I said Linkin Park sucks in a chat room and some dude took offense and nuked my boot sect causing me to freak out a bit until my uncle saved my ass.
